column2: Adverbial clauses of concession with although / though · 专项练习(第2轮)
although/though introduces a concession: cannot be used together with but.本课为专项练习练习,核心:although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。

although = though, placed at the start|the main clause cannot use but, but can use yet/still|even though has a stronger tone|though can appear at the end of a sentence|despite/in spite of + noun also express concession
Although it was cold, we enjoyed the trip.
column3: 虽然天很冷,我们旅行得很愉快。

column1: 「虽然天很冷,我们旅行得很愉快。」的正确英文是?
column2: Although it was cold, we enjoyed the trip.|Despite it was cold, we enjoyed the trip.|Even it was cold, we enjoyed the trip.|Although but it was cold, we enjoyed the trip.
column4: 考查although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。正确句:Although it was cold, we enjoyed the trip.
